surah.personality_title: Al-Kafirun — The Manifesto of Disavowal & The Inviolability of Creed
surah.personality_summary: Defiant, uncompromising, theological boundary-setting. A categorical public repudiation of religious syncretism and theological compromise in response to pagan offers of rotating worship: 'I do not worship what you worship, nor do you worship what I worship... To you your religion, and to me my religion.'
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Kaafiroon (The Disbelievers) is the 109th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 6 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل يا ايها الكافرون

ayahs.translation_saheeh: I do not worship what you worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I do not worship what you worship

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you do not worship what I worship

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I will never worship what you worship

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you will never worship what I worship

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you have your religion and I have mine.’
